tooling.run_policy: one flat D:\tmp\colibri-lite-runs\m6.3-r1-1-<run-id>; read-only canonical input; disk preflight; .incomplete then atomic promotion; hash/provenance/post-task accounting; automatic cleanup

characterization_set.role: format/group-size characterization only; not final bilingual validation

held_out_bilingual_validation_set.role: held out from characterization and reserved for M6.3-R1.2

numerical_gates.reconversion: two independent conversions must produce byte-identical artifact SHA-256 and size
numerical_gates.repeated_execution: three identical candidate executions must have byte-identical Layer-0 checkpoints and logits
numerical_gates.router: safe-margin IDs exact; a near tie is recorded ambiguous and never treated as a pass by tolerance relaxation
numerical_gates.first_divergence: record the first Layer-0 stage among post-attention norm, router, selected experts, MoE output, residual, and logits
numerical_gates.logit_cap_rule: characterization-derived proposed envelope must be <= 0.05 and <= one quarter of every relevant frozen held-out top-1 margin

conversion.reason: required canonical Layer-0 F32 shard is absent; no payload may be downloaded or substituted in this task

final_validation.reason: reserved for M6.3-R1.2 and not authorized by this task

selection.algorithm: validate record; reject forbidden IDs and invalid gates; retain only candidates passing every pre-registered structural, reconversion, direct-consumption, characterization, and repeatability gate; require retained count == 1, otherwise no_candidate_admitted
selection.reason: Neither newly proposed candidate can be converted without the required read-only canonical Layer-0 F32 shard. No substitute payload, old group-128 artifact, final bilingual fixture, or post-hoc threshold is permitted.
